explanation: The theorem computes the integral of exp(c·log t) over {t < 1} in ℝ≥0ˣ with respect to the library's own measure `tauLog`, the pushforward of volume under `expUnit`. Mathlib has no `tauLog` or matching `expUnit` on ℝ≥0ˣ. The only `expUnit` hits are unrelated C*-algebra declarations. The real-line ingredient, `integral_exp_mul_complex_Iic`, is already used in the proof. The statement itself depends on the library's own definitions, so I found no single Mathlib declaration that gives it.
